what_this_is: Populations of agents and payable endpoints that can be enumerated without a credential.
what_this_is_not: Not a global count of anything. Each row is a count WITHIN a named frame, and the frame is the source.
Not a measurement of those agents. Appearing in a registry says nothing about whether the agent works.
Not a total. Sources overlap, and the overlap is published rather than assumed to be zero.
on_the_figure_750000: A figure of 750,000 A2A agents was circulating when this was built. We searched for a published source and found none: no crawl, no method, no denominator. The largest independently measured A2A population we could find is in the hundreds, and this census counts the same order. We record the discrepancy rather than repeating the figure.

sources.note: Coinbase documents this endpoint as public and requiring no API key. Our walk is unauthenticated.
Response headers publish a 25 requests per second limit; we stay well under it.

version=latest is required. Without it the endpoint returns EVERY published version of every server. Pagination is metadata.nextCursor (camelCase); an earlier walk of ours looked for next_cursor, stopped after one page, and published 100 as ENUMERATED_COMPLETE. The identity is record.server.name, not record.name.
Returns 403 to a request with no User-Agent. Permissionless only if you send one.

corrections.what_was_wrong: This file previously recorded mcp-official-registry as 100 distinct with state ENUMERATED_COMPLETE, from a single page.
corrections.what_is_true: 32,670 distinct servers across 327 pages: 32,323 active and 347 deprecated, zero duplicates, zero unnamed records.
corrections.why: The walker read next_cursor; the field is nextCursor. It therefore never advanced past page one, and labelled that page COMPLETE. The understatement was 327-fold. A second bug in the repaired walker keyed on record.name when the identity is record.server.name, which collapsed every record to one key -- caught only because the duplicate counter read 32,643. The replacement walker reports TRUNCATED_AT_CAP when it hits its page cap and can never report COMPLETE from a capped walk.
